_comment_claudeArgs: REQUIRED and explicit. There is deliberately no default: the previous build defaulted a missing claudeArgs to --dangerously-skip-permissions, which silently bypassed the host's permission setup. If this host genuinely needs a permission-bypass flag, add it here AND set acknowledgeDangerousClaudeArgs to true, so the decision is recorded and reviewable.
_comment_promptDelivery: stdin is the ONLY accepted value, and the default. argv delivery was removed: it put the complete task on the child's command line at process-creation time, so the child could read and begin executing it before the durable child-identity handoff gate had committed - and no later abort can prove it had not. With stdin the prompt IS the task and it is written only after the identity record and the lock heartbeat are durable.
_comment_worktreeRoot: D-133. Root for the ISOLATED linked git worktree each task gets, keyed by TASK_ID. It must be OUTSIDE repoPath, which is asserted at load time: the whole point is that a task's uncommitted work can never appear in the primary checkout the dirty guard protects. Optional - it defaults to a SIBLING of scratchRoot (not a child: scratchRoot is handed to the child as TEMP, and a worktree holding real uncommitted work must not live where a temp sweeper may delete it), so an existing config does not have to change.
_comment_admissionRoot: D-166. Where the CROSS-WORKER task admission leases live - one append-only, versioned lease per TASK_ID, taken before the ACK, the worktree and the dispatch. Deliberately NOT under logDir, scratchRoot or worktreeRoot: every one of those is a property of ONE deployment, and two workers installed under two roots would then never contend for the same path - which is exactly how two workers came to own D-165 at once. Optional, and normally LEFT OUT: the default is derived from the control-plane identity the contenders necessarily share, <home>/.jarvis-worker-admission/<repoOwner>__<repoName>__issue<controlIssue>, so two independently installed workers meet without either of them being configured for it. Set it explicitly ONLY to move the shared location (then EVERY worker on this host must be given the SAME value), or to isolate a test rig on purpose. It must be outside repoPath, which is asserted at load time.
_comment_postMergeEvidence: D-146. Optional. This host's policy for what an AUTHORIZED MERGE task must prove AFTER the merge. requiredChecks: the check-run names that must each exist EXACTLY ONCE on the merge commit with status=completed and conclusion=success - missing, duplicate, unfinished, neutral, skipped, cancelled and failed all fail closed, and a check outside the set NEVER substitutes for one inside it. extraChecksPolicy: ignore | must_not_fail (default) | forbid, for check runs outside the required set. profile: which closeout-evidence profile the trusted terminal report must satisfy (merge_closeout_v1). Resolution order is the task's own trusted ARCHITECT_TASK (REQUIRED_POST_MERGE_CHECKS=, EXTRA_POST_MERGE_CHECKS=, POST_MERGE_EVIDENCE_PROFILE=, REQUIRED_CLOSEOUT_FIELDS=), then this key, then the repository's real CI jobs. Omitting this key is safe; setting requiredChecks to [] is NOT a bypass - it makes every authorized merge task fail closed for lack of a decidable policy.
